- Never print a full-branch git diff: run git diff --stat first, then diff one file at a time.
- rm absolute paths, never $VAR/* or a path behind cd: write rm -rf -- "${D:?}"/x so an empty variable cannot widen the target.
- Run scratch scripts that import project packages from inside the project (bun -e, or a file under the repo), not from /tmp: modules resolve from the script's own directory.

- quote the separator: echo "===" — zsh expands a bare === to a command name, exits 1, and never runs the rest of the line
- zsh: an unmatched glob aborts the command even with 2>/dev/null. List with find or fd, or quote the pattern.
- Never print a full-branch git diff: run git diff --stat first, then diff one file at a time.
- rm absolute paths, never $VAR/* or a path behind cd: write rm -rf -- "${D:?}"/x so an empty variable cannot widen the target.
- Run scratch scripts that import project packages from inside the project (bun -e, or a file under the repo), not from /tmp: modules resolve from the script's own directory.

SUGGESTED RULES  (copy into CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md; causes already stated are not repeated)
- pkill -f PAT matches the harness shell, whose command line holds the whole call, and kills it (exit 144). Kill by name (pkill -x NAME) or by a saved PID (kill "$(cat srv.pid)"). A bracketed '[p]attern' helps only when no other part of the call repeats the plain text: pkill -f '[b]un run dev'; bun run dev & still dies.
- Don't sleep N && cmd: wait with an until-loop (until grep -q DONE f; do sleep 2; done), Monitor, or run_in_background.
- quote the separator: echo "===" — zsh expands a bare === to a command name, exits 1, and never runs the rest of the line
- zsh: an unmatched glob aborts the command even with 2>/dev/null. List with find or fd, or quote the pattern.
- Never print a full-branch git diff: run git diff --stat first, then diff one file at a time.
- rm absolute paths, never $VAR/* or a path behind cd: write rm -rf -- "${D:?}"/x so an empty variable cannot widen the target.
- Run scratch scripts that import project packages from inside the project (bun -e, or a file under the repo), not from /tmp: modules resolve from the script's own directory.

- zsh: an unmatched glob aborts the command even with 2>/dev/null. List with find or fd, or quote the pattern.

A bracketed '[p]attern' helps only when no other part of the call repeats the plain text: pkill -f '[b]un run dev'; bun run dev & still dies.
- Don't sleep N && cmd: wait with an until-loop (until grep -q DONE f; do sleep 2; done), Monitor, or run_in_background.

- Never print a full-branch git diff: run git diff --stat first, then diff one file at a time.
